mapper.select: SELECT a.UserId AS AuthorId, a.PenName, a.Bio, u.AvatarUrl, a.IsVerified, a.FollowerCount, a.CreatedAt AS AuthorSince, st.StoryCount, st.ChapterCount, st.ViewCount, st.RatingCount, st.RatingAvg FROM dbo.Author a JOIN dbo.[User] u ON u.UserId = a.UserId CROSS APPLY ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS StoryCount, COALESCE(SUM(CAST(p.ChapterCount AS BIGINT)), 0) AS ChapterCount, COALESCE(SUM(p.ViewCount), 0) AS ViewCount, COALESCE(SUM(CAST(p.RatingCount AS BIGINT)), 0) AS RatingCount, COALESCE(CAST(SUM(CAST(p.RatingAvg AS DECIMAL(18,4)) * p.RatingCount) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(p.RatingCount AS DECIMAL(18,4))), 0) AS DECIMAL(3,2)), 0) AS RatingAvg FROM dbo.vw_PublicStory p WHERE p.AuthorId = a.UserId ) st WHERE a.UserId = #{authorId}
SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Author WHERE UserId = #{authorId}) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
